developments.reason: Implemented the actual two batched world-38 reviews at round 12 with two ex12-only abilities and one shared composition schema. Real owned roots, stones and bark enter conserved persistent escrow; paid rounds, interruption, cancellation and death preserve partial progress and actual materials without refunds or duplication. Crushing preserves nutrition, age and represented composition; reviewed previously unknown water composition is explicitly initialized to 50 percent, never free nutrients. Weather-driven drying and rewetting change actual mass, water ledger and future decay rate, with no age reset; unloaded food remains exposed. Reusable trays retain real components, qualified other members can use empty trays, and simultaneous contested loads retain the existing all-conflicts-rejected rule. Previously prepared food is an actual compatible input with retained provenance and reduced remaining work. Existing canonical meal feedback is reused unchanged instead of adding the redundant proposed reward or changing its frozen window. No mastery, stock or output is granted at installation. Generic ex11 escrow/profile implementation reuse is attributed; A abilities and historical preservation effects remain excluded. Eight targeted actual-kernel tests passed, covering actual eating, input conservation, failure/recovery/death, expiry cleanup, composition, second-person use, moisture and decay, A/B isolation and restore. Browser fixture passed and all six final screenshots were personally inspected: readable paid work, actual material counts and food, empty reusable tray, 12 percent dry food at 0.35 decay, and 15.2 percent rewetted food at 1.25 decay. Initial overlapping tool labels and stale fixture work events were corrected and recaptured. Fixtures are isolated from formal decisions and are not emergence evidence. Full handoff validation and exact twelve-round prefix reconstruction remain mandatory. Seed, resource baseline, incentive policy and committed history are unchanged; internal development tokens remain unobservable.
Versioned development validation failed: pnpm architecture:check

Development attempt 2 failed the architecture gate due to a new material-adapter/accounting cycle; its log and budget charge remain. Removed the reverse dependency by reading the already resolved unprocessed material mass directly, and the standalone architecture gate plus nine targeted tests now pass. No model call or world round occurred between attempts. Implemented the actual world-92 bark request as a small ex12-only branch-processing precursor. Inspected retained target region-1-canopy-18: finite exposed branches, no represented trunk tissue. Installation does not modify that tree, grant stock, tools, source knowledge or mastery. Otherwise unspecified intact branch material partitions at most ten percent existing mass, with known processing/composition overriding that default; actual water, solids, fuel, nutrients, toxins, age and provenance are conserved. Usable bark rounds down to exact tenths, leaving real fines rather than upward rounding. One branch is insufficient for a full bark implement. Personally assessed actual stone/flint contact and intrinsic hardness are required; generic ex10 contact and ex11 escrow code reuse is attributed without activating historical skills or knowledge. Two paid effort units per original branch unit are proportional for fractional/partial inputs; integer remaining simulation rounds are distinct from fractional effort. Exact ongoing inputs cannot be silently replaced. Pauses retain progress; cancellation/death release actual partial material and tool once. Finished residual wood cannot be re-peeled into a new layer or satisfy intact-branch recipes. Shared per-lot profiles retain chemical accounting for future compatible consumers; no combustion function is claimed. Inspection awards nothing; only newly verified paid separation uses the unchanged canonical understanding rule. Nine targeted tests passed, including true produced-bark use by prior root preparation, mass/water/fuel/nutrient/toxin conservation, missing inputs, contradictory material, death/cancel/resume, exact references, whole and fractional full-execution repeats, fresh isolation and individual mastery. An initial cursor test used an obsolete local reference and was corrected to inspect the kernel-updated cursor. Four final browser images were personally reviewed after fixing cancelled-material label overlap: unresolved standing trunk, paid partial work, conserved outputs, retained cancellation; standing-tree geometry stays unchanged. Whole-unit base pickup remains a documented limitation for ground fractional output, which stays physical and is not rounded into inventory. Fixtures are not formal discoveries. Full handoff gates and exact 28-round prefix reconstruction remain mandatory; frozen goals, resource baseline, reward parameters and prior formal history are unchanged. Internal development tokens are unobservable, not zero.
